record_title: Odd-quotient characteristic-two hull universality for generalized Roth--Lempel codes
provenance: A characteristic-two extension of the GRL prescribed-hull method of Wu--Liu--Chen--Zhou, using the odd-quotient power-map bijection together with their polynomial Galois-dual characterization.
limitations: The theorem retains the low-degree range k<=floor((n+2^ell-1)/(2^ell+1)), does not classify MDS/AMDS/NMDS GRL skeletons, and does not cover odd characteristic. The power-map lemma and the analogous odd-quotient GRS regime are prior art. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.20453 is very recent.
